claim: The Americas' share of WSTS world billings rose from 19.1% in 2019 to 32.2% in 2025 (+13.1 percentage points), the largest six-year rise for the Americas in the 1986-2025 series but smaller than Asia Pacific's +21.9-point rise from 2000 to 2006.
notes: Inference from SRC-0223 regional and worldwide annual totals; corrects the 'sharpest regional shift in the series' wording of CLM-0695. Largest six-year share changes by region computed over all windows 1986-2025.
